purpose: Correct CAM-0005 bug (candidate point erroneously included in its own nearest-neighbor list); reattempt necessary convex-ear obstruction and independently cross-check any candidate via exact chronological DFS.
bounds: Seed 150128; n=4..12; max 500 constructed integer sets per n, three generator families; distinct/no-collinear/all vertices extreme; exact nearest-two excludes the candidate vertex. 75-second checked timeout; at most 300000 DFS nodes for each found no-ear set.
stopping_rule: Stop at first convex candidate with no hull-neighbour nearest-two vertex, or all n=4..12 sets completed, or 75 elapsed seconds checked after each tested sample. Do not reinterpret a CAPPED DFS as infeasible.
